question: During photosynthesis, the carbohydrates synthesised are stored in the form of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Starch__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Starch**

__
 
• The food synthesized by the plant is stored as Starch.
 
• Starch is the food that gets stored in **plant leaves.**
 
• Starch is a **polymeric carbohydrate **consisting of a large number of glucose units linked by glycosidic bonds.
 
• It acts as stored energy in plants.
 
• Food making process in plants is called **photosynthesis **and synthesized food is stored as carbohydrates (glucose as well as starch).
 
• Plants are known as **photoautotrophs or photosynthetic organisms** which means that they are able to synthesize their food directly from carbon dioxide and water using energy from light.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Proteins are large molecules made of smaller units called **amino acids**.

 
 
• They are essential for building and repairing tissues in the body.
 
 
 
• Fats are a type of nutrient that provides energy, helps in the absorption of vitamins, and supports cell function.
 
 
• Fats are made of **fatty acids** and **glycerol**.
 
 
 
• Vitamins are organic compounds needed in small amounts for the body to function properly.
 
 
• They do not provide energy but are essential for various metabolic processes.
